description: Files a refund request for a past order. It only files a request: a person reviews it and replies by email. It never refunds anything by itself and never takes card details, so never send card numbers. Needs the order email, the Stripe receipt number or order number, and a reason.

email.description: Email address used for the order.

items.description: Optional: which items, with color and size.

order_reference.description: Stripe receipt number (like 1234-5678) or order number (like CWS-AB12CD34EF).

reason.description: What went wrong, for example damaged, misprinted, wrong item or lost in transit.

name: request_refund
